guide.summary: Drying gel with one water channel, a moisture wick on its bank and a shade roof on the far side.
guide.biology: As gel dries, life that can rest out the dry spell or hide under cover keeps going.
guide.rules: Gel everywhere except a water channel eight cells wide (x 24 to 31) from rim to rim; no stones. Moisture 1 in water and 0.8 in gel at the start; drying is on. A moisture wick at (32,64) on the channel's bank; a shade roof over a circle of radius 8 at (88,64). Light 0.5, warmth 0.5, oxygen 0.8, carbon dioxide 0.5, nutrient 0.10 and sugar 0.02 in every cell. Lid open; fixed light.
guide.example: Watch the moisture overlay: which parts of the gel stay damp longest?
